description: A finite empty derivation through a cycle does not create a nonempty prefix (engine §2.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X r | Y r
%rule r prefix ($a:aa ≻ $b:bb) :: ∅
%conditions $a.tags = A ∧ ¬$.preceded-by(X)
%rule aa A
%rule bb A
%rule prefix ε | loop
%rule loop prefix
